topic: keep a cake from sticking to the baking pan
core_question: How do you keep a cake from sticking to the pan when baking? (secondary: How do you jump start a car that won't start because the battery is dead?)
answer_summary: Coat the inside of the pan with butter or shortening, dust with flour and tap out the excess (or line the bottom with a parchment paper round), so the baked cake releases cleanly after cooling briefly.; after the topic shift: Attach jumper cables red-to-positive on both batteries, black-to-negative on the good battery, then the last black clamp to an unpainted metal ground on the dead car (not its negative terminal); start the working car, let it run a few minutes, then start the dead car.
